details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support each other without contradictions. Revenue growth drivers are clearly identified in S5-S7, segment performance is consistently described in S10-S13, and financial metrics show clear directional changes across S1-S4 and S14-S20. The transition from a two-tier governance structure noted in S21 is presented as a post-period event without conflicting with earlier statements. There are no arithmetic contradictions because the summary never claims that segment figures should sum to consolidated totals. The organization flows logically from consolidated performance to segment details to cash flow and governance changes.
